content: Baleꞌu ꞌana nuwaꞌewa
Toꞌaha weyahina ꞌaleha ma heꞌahupanapanawa silatulatu ꞌoimiya? Nuwana waboi ꞌimi nuwaꞌubuna ꞌoidiyega, weyahina tuta mabwaiyana hali mumuga ma hali mumuga ꞌalomiya sipaipaihowa.

Ceta tuta nuwanuwami ꞌiyamiyao ꞌidi tobwatobwa waꞌewadi, ta geya sawasawahimi, ꞌoinega waloheꞌamasidi. Ta ginaulaedi wanuwatuhu dahwanedi geya sawasawahimi ma waꞌewadi, ꞌoinega ꞌiyamiyao ꞌoidiya waꞌalaꞌala ꞌoheꞌohe ma waheꞌupwa. Ma ginaulaedi geya wada lobediya weyahina geya weyahidi wada ꞌahwanoiya Yehoba ꞌoina.
Ma ꞌeguma weyahidi waꞌahwanoi, geya wada lobediya, beno weyahina ꞌimi ꞌahwanoi geya dumwaludi, weyahina ꞌimi ꞌahwanoiyedi waboimo ꞌimi yaliyaya weyahina.
Comi tohemisa ꞌaboꞌabowao! Ceguma baleꞌu mumugaina wahelauweya, beno Yehoba waloꞌaleheya, weyahina ꞌeguma taiya baleꞌu mumugaina nuwanuwana, tauna Yehoba ꞌana ꞌaleha.
Coinega sahena Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌina hepwaila waꞌahwaꞌahwa muhemuheye tutaina ꞌigwae,

content.text: “Yaluyaluwaina Yehoba ꞌilaguya ꞌoida nuwanuwana madouna tauda.”

content: Ma hesi Yehoba ꞌina lema ꞌoida ꞌimadou hedade, weyahina Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina ꞌihepwaila ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Yehoba togagasa ꞌiꞌausidi, ma hesi tonuwasulu ꞌoidiya ꞌitagwala ma ꞌilemedi.”

content: Coinega Yehoba ꞌoina watagwalegomi, ma Tomudulele walogwahate ma tauna ꞌiꞌebesinegomi.
Ta wanao Yehoba deina ma ꞌoinega tauna wete ꞌinaowa deimiya. Ta ꞌomi galami ma toꞌabo ꞌilobwaineya ma nimami wadeulidi ma ꞌatemi wagiheꞌehaudi.
Ta wete ꞌimi mumuga galadi weyahidi wadou gwaegwae maꞌimi nuwagala, eema ꞌimi hedagiyao wagibui ma wadou, ta wete ꞌimi yaliyaya wagibuidi ma wanuwagala,
ta wanuwasulu Bada matana, ma ꞌoinega tauna ꞌigilagasigomi.
Cahwa galagala hali tomota weyahidi
Tasigwao, sahena tasimiyao waꞌahwa galaedi, weyahina ꞌeguma taiya tauna tasina ꞌiꞌahwagalae, nuwana ꞌiloinae, tauna geya Yehoba ꞌina loina ꞌimuliye, ta hesi loinaina ꞌiꞌahwa galaeya.
Yehoba ꞌiboimo loina ꞌana toꞌebwaya, ma wete toloina, tauna sawasawahina ꞌiꞌabihete bo ꞌiloheꞌamasa, ꞌoinega ꞌomi sahena ꞌiyamiyao waꞌahwa galagalaedi bo waloiloinaedi.
Sahena gwaehane

Gwae bewa wahesagohe, ꞌeguma taiyawedi ꞌoimiyega wagwae gagasa ma wagwae, “Nata bo gona ꞌatautauya ꞌasa madouna ꞌoina, ta nobwa bolime ꞌaigeda ꞌamiyamiya ma tauma ꞌima paihowa ꞌapaihowadi, ma ꞌahewasawasa,”
ma hesi geya wasanapu yawasimi ꞌina tautauya gona weyahina, weyahina tauda tomota gidemusa hogahoga. Cihapwesa tuta ꞌiꞌiuna tuwa, ta wete ꞌilohesawala hila.
Ma hesi ꞌilobwaineya ma wagwae, “Ceguma Bada ꞌitagwala, ꞌada miyamiya ma ginaulaedi nuwanuwama ꞌada paihowadi.”
Nata bewa wagagasa ma wagwaehane, ma hesi gwae haneina galana.
Coinega ꞌeguma taiya paihowa bwebweꞌadi ꞌisanapudiya, ma geya ꞌida paihowediya, beno ꞌina pui.
